name: Essential Color Grading LUTs
description: Film emulations and editor's-choice color grading LUTs.
tagline: Film emulation and editor's-choice color grading LUTs
summary: One-click color grading LUTs, including film emulations of classic stocks and hand-made grades. Each LUT has an intensity slider so you can make it as subtle as you like.
useCases: Give a whole video a consistent grade quickly
Start from a grade and fine-tune it
howTo: Select a clip and open the Color workspace
Open the Color Grading LUTs panel
Click a LUT to preview it
Use the intensity slider to blend it in
